permanent_scope: One bounded postexport head optimizer attempt stopped at deadline. No exported mesh, cache refresh, final quality or independent saved-file read.
whitelist_projections: Controller execution minus actual command, duplicate worker and samples.
Preflight specification/scopes plus role-labelled evidence, snapshot and runtime digests.
new_postrun_summaries: Outcome, resource summary, source bindings, reader-not-run status, this provenance and README.
private_omissions: Actual executed command and native process identifiers.
Absolute runtime/interpreter/host paths, runtime binaries and complete native log.
Large candidate/input mesh arrays and prepared, unexecuted reader sources.
public_reproduction_scope: Hashes, source bindings and complete scalar/resource aggregation can be checked without native execution. No final geometry is available to reproduce or qualify.
